text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf, who is finally
taking on the Senior year this year.

To pray for her success,
we came together for the first shrine visit of the New Year, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Well, well, if it isn't the teachers.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Rudolf-kun!
Are you here for your New Year's visit as well?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The Student Council planned to visit you together later, but...
please excuse me for offering a brief greeting first.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Teacher B
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind. Naturally, what you all
wish for would be about the race."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But as the student council president,
I thought I would also pray for the academy's further prosperity.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Teacher C
text_block_list.text:
"She really is such a hardworking girl~
She's earned quite a reputation among the students for being dependable!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...No, I'm hardly reliable.

For a brief second, Symboli Rudolf's expression clouded over.
But immediately after—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My parents often scold me,
saying "no news is not good news" from me.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Oops, who said that pun, I wonder?
Just kidding! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
T-Teacher, is that...!
Heheheh...!

...It seems there is some kind of resemblance
between the teachers' taste and hers.
After parting ways with the teachers――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Mmm.
She's groaning, seemingly troubled over something...

I thought I might be able to ask why her expression
clouded over for a moment back there—or so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
How uncharacteristic of me
to have made such a blunder.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“—To resort to falsehoods...
just for the sake of a pun...!”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I have never once delayed writing home to my parents, much less been rebuked for it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And yet, I gave the teachers a false report.
A pun is nothing without its context, after all!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Jumping at a passing whim was short-sighted and rash.
I must deeply reflect on this..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right.
There's no time to be writhing in agony.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My schedule after this is packed.
I need to finish offering my prayers quickly.
choice_data_list: Busy right from the New Year, huh?
Busy right from the New Year, huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It's precisely *because* it's the new year.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Paying visits to relevant parties, the new fiscal year kickoff rally,
carrying over tasks from the end of the year... The work is quite diverse.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And so, we don't have much time.
Let's get right down to business.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's generally said that a wish voiced aloud won't come true,
but there is also the virtue of putting words into action.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: From our perspective, we would like to align our understanding through words and make it a mutual pledge. How does that sound?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then tell me your wish right away.
choice_data_list: "Food as Medicine" — taking care of health through diet

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, that resolve is essential.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This year is bound to be extremely busy, so
we must be even more cautious than usual.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-kun.
I have just the thing suited for this topic.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's a stall selling that "drinkable IV drip,"
you see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Correct.
Why don't we have a quick drink?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If it's under the pretense of nutritional intake,
resting for about five minutes shouldn't be an issue.

Afterward, I shared an amazake toast
with Symboli Rudolf and enjoyed a brief rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, how audacious.
Declaring yourself omniscient and omnipotent, are you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You truly wish to become an entity
on par with the gods of myth, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even if it proves to be a path stretched far beyond the horizon...
that is precisely what I desire.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Above all, I like your resolve...
making such an arrogant pledge without batting an eye.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let us walk the path to becoming the strongest together.
—I'll be counting on you again this year.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ooh...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Have you finally come to understand?
The sheer utility of puns!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If we work together to refine our punning skills,
we won't make a blunder like that ever again.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's set up a study session right away.
Please prepare a rough draft before then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let's see... If we have 100 of them, would that be enough to discuss?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll leave it in your hands.
I will select something truly special as well.
Afterward, thanks to Symboli Rudolf's extraordinary passion, the pun study session was successfully held, and—

Her joke skills have also "j-ok"-ed up a bit,
making all the hard work worth it
...or was it?!
